name: Get trend
summary: This EA identifies trend direction using technical indicators and opens trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It aims to capture sustained directional moves by entering when trend conditions are confirmed. The system typically uses moving averages or similar trend-following indicators to determine market direction.
summary_zh: 该EA通过技术指标识别趋势方向，并在趋势确认后顺势开仓。它旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情，通常使用移动均线或类似趋势跟踪指标来判断市场方向。
strategy_analysis: 该EA属于典型的趋势跟踪策略，通过技术指标判断市场当前趋势方向后顺势入场。入场条件通常基于均线交叉、价格突破均线或趋势指标的方向确认。出场条件可能包括反向信号出现、固定止损止盈或跟踪止损。仓位管理可能采用固定手数或基于账户资金的动态计算方式。资金管理方面可能包含简单的风险控制如止损设置，但具体细节需查看源码确认。整体策略逻辑依赖于趋势的持续性，在震荡市中可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a classic trend-following strategy that identifies the prevailing market direction using technical indicators and enters trades in alignment with the detected trend. Entry conditions are typically based on moving average crossovers, price breaking above/below key moving averages, or directional confirmation from trend indicators like ADX. Exit conditions may include opposing signal generation, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, or trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing likely uses either fixed lot sizes or an account-equity-based dynamic calculation approach. Money management may incorporate basic risk controls such as stop-loss placement, though the specifics depend on the source code implementation. The overall strategy logic depends on trend persistence and is vulnerable to whipsaw losses in ranging or choppy markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, limits max loss per trade

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 趋势跟踪策略在明确趋势行情中能够捕获大波段利润
顺势交易符合市场主流规律，长期逻辑合理
结构相对简单，参数可调便于优化适应不同品种
pros_en: Trend-following strategy can capture large directional moves in clear trending markets
Trading with the trend aligns with fundamental market principles and has sound long-term logic
Relatively simple structure with adjustable parameters allows optimization for different instruments
cons: 震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
趋势跟踪存在滞后性，入场和出场时机可能不够精确
缺乏对市场状态(趋势/震荡)的自适应切换机制
cons_en: Vulnerable to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets
Trend-following inherently lags price action, leading to suboptimal entry and exit timing
Lacks adaptive market regime detection to switch between trend and range trading modes
improvements: 增加市场状态识别机制，在震荡行情中减少交易或暂停开仓
加入移动止损或跟踪止损以更好地保护利润
增加多时间框架确认，提高信号可靠性
improvements_en: Add market regime detection to reduce or pause trading during ranging conditions
Implement trailing stop or dynamic stop-loss to better protect accumulated profits
Add multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal reliability and reduce false entries

risk_points: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能出现连续亏损
缺乏自适应市场状态切换可能在不适合的行情中持续开仓
止损设置可能不够灵活，在剧烈波动中存在滑点风险
risk_points_en: Trend-following strategy may produce consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lack of adaptive market regime switching may cause continued entries in unfavorable conditions
Stop-loss settings may lack flexibility, creating slippage risk during high volatility

The system typically uses moving averages or similar trend-following indicators to determine market direction.
